text: 9月7日，中国证监会主席吴清在京会见了阿曼金融服务管理局执行总裁萨尔米。双方就加强中阿资本市场合作及中国资本市场改革开放成效等议题交换了意见。（证监会网站）
text_en: On September 7, CSRC Chairman Wu Qing met with Sultan Al Salmi, CEO of Oman's Financial Services Authority, in Beijing. The two sides exchanged views on strengthening China-Oman capital market cooperation and progress in China's capital market reform and opening-up. (CSRC website)
